captions.detailed: A 2x camera teleconverter featuring a central black cylindrical body flanked by two silver cylindrical bayonet mount rings. The upper bayonet ring features a small red alignment dot on its rim, while the lower ring includes a protruding silver alignment peg. A central black grip ring around the body has a small red release switch next to a silver accent.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a 2x camera teleconverter with a black cylindrical main body and silver bayonet mount rings on the top and bottom. The top bayonet ring should be rotatable with a red alignment dot, and the bottom ring should include a small silver alignment peg.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a black Cylinder primitive. Model the top and bottom bayonet rings as grey/silver hollow cylinders with rectangular tabs added via polar arrays. Add a small red sphere on the top ring as an alignment dot, and attach a small cylindrical peg to the bottom ring. Create the central grip ring with a red release button and a silver lock slider, joining the components with revolute joints to allow rotation of the mount interfaces.
